scientific_integrity: The analytic invariant and asymptotics are proved under stated two-agent hypotheses; numerical diagnostics are finite corroboration, not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two reciprocal agents; fixed unit self-weights; homogeneous responsiveness; smooth positive strictly decreasing interaction crossing one-half transversely. Does not classify networks of three or more agents, alternate normalizations, or nontransverse crossings. General literature-equivalence risk remains.
title: Exact trust–disagreement separatrix and critical slowing in two-agent adaptive opinion dynamics
